query:
UPDATE governor_races SET
  rep_candidate = 'Christine Drazan',
  rep_previous_office = '2022 Republican gubernatorial nominee; former Oregon House Minority Leader',
  rep_bio = 'Christine Drazan was the 2022 Republican gubernatorial nominee, losing to Tina Kotek by 2.5% in a three-way race. A former Oregon House Minority Leader, she is the frontrunner in the 2026 Republican primary. Republican primary also includes Chris Dudley (former NBA player and 2010 nominee), Danielle Bethell, and others.',
  notes = 'Incumbent Tina Kotek (D) seeking re-election. Primary May 19, 2026. D primary: Kotek runs essentially unopposed. R primary: Christine Drazan (2022 nominee, frontrunner), Chris Dudley (2010 nominee), Danielle Bethell, and 11 others. Rated Solid D — Kotek won 2022 by 2.5% in a three-way race; without a third-party spoiler, margin expected to be wider.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR';
